GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported intention was to settle forward. After beginning on terms was steadied when tightened between runners, then directed behind runners where it dropped the bit and failed to respond to urgings, settling at the rear and becoming detached.

Improving 3 Wide from 550m & pushed along Four Wide (1.5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & tried to go with winner @ 200m. No match late. # Every Chance

Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed same until 3 Wide @ 1000m & pushed to quicken @ 750m. Back to rear @ 600m & struggled in last 400m. # Beaten @ 500m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding settling back, apprentice rider stated that she was instructed to settle further back from the gate to prevent racing wide and without cover. Trainer agreed with the instructions given. Trainer was reminded of his obligation to notify any change of tactics from the most recent start.
